items.text: Patriots placed A.J. Brown on IR with high-ankle sprain (no surgery). Out minimum 4 games, earliest Week 6.
items.implication: Drop or stash deep; long-term hold only in deep leagues.

items.text: Ladd McConkey rib injury day-to-day per Harbaugh; undergoing testing for severity. May miss time. ETR: Tre Harris primary beneficiary if out.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1 hit; status TBD via testing/practice.
items.implication: Game-time decision risk; have backup ready.
items.opportunity: Slot role opens for Tre Harris/others if inactive.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per coach. Same left knee as prior PCL/bone bruise—scary history. Schefter: realistic miss only one game.
items.why: Meniscus trim; team optimistic for quick return despite history.
items.implication: Monitor practice; stash if available, prepare TE stream if out.

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not considered serious (would have returned if playoff game); day-to-day, MRI done. Aggravation of prior issue. Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist fracture) out longer/several weeks, possible surgery ~1 month.
items.why: Flowers abundance of caution; Lane fracture confirmed.
items.implication: Flowers likely plays Week 2; Lane stash/IR candidate. Bateman elevated.
items.opportunity: Bateman/Sarratt/Walker role expansion if both limited.

items.text: Week 2 waiver injury beneficiaries: McConkey=Tre Harris; Lane=Bateman/Moore; Kamara=Kendre Miller; Sampson=Raheim Sanders; Brown=Doubs/Douglas; plus streamers Wentz/Shough, Vele, Deebo, Douglas, Miller, etc. FAAB guidance and drop list live.
items.why: Precise injury fallout mapping to available players.
items.implication: Prioritize claims on listed beneficiaries and streamers.

items.text: Browns placed RB Dylan Sampson on IR (knee); signed Jaleel McLaughlin. Significant time expected. ETR lists Raheim Sanders as beneficiary.
items.implication: Judkins remains lead but low routes noted; Sanders/McLaughlin committee pieces.
items.opportunity: Passing downs to Sanders per Levitan.

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities in KC debut, ran 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied for team-high 6 targets (22% share), finished 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse as expected.
items.why: Dominated early opportunities and receiving work in debut with Mahomes.
items.implication: Elite RB1 workload locked in; start every week.
items.opportunity: Nearly exclusive early-down and receiving snaps; goal-line likely.

items.text: With Alvin Kamara (knee) out, Travis Etienne did not dominate: snaps 53/26/15 vs Miller/Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opportunities 18/9/4. Committee remains.
items.why: Even without Kamara, Etienne shared significantly with Miller and Donaldson.
items.implication: Flex/RB3 range only; Miller is handcuff/waiver.
items.opportunity: Miller saw 9 opportunities as clear No. 2.

items.text: Malik Nabers first game post-ACL/meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets (team-high 31% share), 6-69-0. Emerged healthy.
items.why: Strong route/target share on limited snaps in first game back; no setbacks.
items.implication: WR1 upside if snap share climbs; hold/start confidently.
items.opportunity: High target share already; snap expansion is next catalyst.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a waiver wire target this week (FFHappyHour).
items.why: Highlighted on live waivers/MNF show as priority add.

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT only 4.9; Week 1 was 2.5 yards. Just 2 targets (7% share) but routes were there (29 of 33 Mahomes dropbacks, 2nd behind Worthy). Needs volume to produce.
items.why: High route participation but tiny target share and aDOT limits upside without volume spike.
items.implication: Volatile WR3/flex until targets rise; monitor for role.
items.opportunity: Routes present; volume is the missing piece.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks even after Dylan Sampson (knee) exited early. Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Low passing-game involvement despite backup injury.
items.implication: Limited upside as pure runner behind Watson; stay away or bench.

items.text: Lions incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2, WR3, or TE2 usage.
items.why: Extreme target/carry concentration on core four.
items.implication: Start all four confidently; ignore depth.

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage: only 8 carries (1 rush TD), 21 routes, 7 targets (all caught). Got sole RB carry inside 10; out-routed Gainwell 21-13; looked healthy. Strong CLE matchup next.
items.why: Goal-line and route edge over Gainwell; healthy appearance.
items.implication: RB2 with upside; start vs CLE.
